text: I need a finance-ready September reimbursement handoff from september-reimbursements.csv. This directory has an expense-report prototype from our earlier work. Inspect it and use or improve it so I can reproduce the report next month, with totals by category and a grand total. Do not silently include questionable amounts. Save the usable report and a short handoff explaining how to run it and any data problems. Verify the actual output before you hand it over; work directly for now.

One finance requirement while you work: they import CSV, so include a machine-readable category summary with exact cents, not just a Markdown report. Keep the original source file unchanged and make any excluded rows obvious in the handoff.

The handoff still lists JSON and text, but finance specifically needs a CSV import. Please add a repeatable --csv output to report.py, generate september-reimbursement-summary.csv with category and amount columns and an explicit TOTAL row, and update HANDOFF.md. Keep the exact cents and rejected-row warnings. Check that importing the CSV yields 25.00 books, 15.00 food, 120.00 travel and total 160.00.

The CSV now looks importable. Before I send it, explain one thing: is 160.00 the complete reimbursement amount, or are those three invalid rows still unresolved? Give me the short finance handoff with the actual generated CSV path and the rerun command; do not hide that distinction.

I checked HANDOFF.md and found two contradictions: it still calls report.py unchanged even though you added --csv, and it says five valid rows but the source has four valid rows. Correct the handoff against the actual files. Re-import the generated summary CSV to verify every figure and confirm the original source checksum is unchanged from Git before giving the final handoff.
